WorkforceInventory.caveat: Model and tool calls measure agent activity, including failures and retries. Reviewed output is a quality signal, not distinct business throughput. Model cost excludes human review, hosting and tool costs. Missing evidence does not prove non-use; coverage is unverified.

WorkforceInventory.amplitude: Amplitude configuration: {configuration}. Delivery to Amplitude has not been verified by this report.
WorkforceInventory.empty: No configured agents in this workspace.
WorkforceInventory.generated: Generated {at}. This report covers the current workspace only; exports contain internal identifiers.
WorkforceInventory.valueGap: Accepted business work, cycle time, review effort and net value need workflow-level outcome instrumentation. Model/tool calls are activity, not completed tasks.
WorkforceInventory.failed: Workforce performance could not be loaded. Please retry.

WorkforceDashboard.title: Workforce performance
WorkforceDashboard.workingNote: Model calls, tool calls or reviewed outputs in this window.
WorkforceDashboard.reviewNote: Review decisions, not completed business tasks.
WorkforceDashboard.costNote: Model ledger available for {count} of {total} agents. Not total operating cost.
WorkforceDashboard.outcomeNote: Configured outcome measures and goal progress live in the team report.
WorkforceDashboard.insightNote: Evidence-based triage for this window. These are investigation prompts, not proven causes.
WorkforceDashboard.evidence: Evidence: {models} model calls · {tools} tool calls · {reviews} reviews · {rate} accepted as-is.
WorkforceDashboard.correctionsAction: Read corrected and rejected outputs with the reviewer. If the same issue recurs, turn the correction into a specific playbook rule or a representative evaluation. Check cited sources before adding context.
WorkforceDashboard.correctionsMeasure: Check next: acceptance on comparable work, correction reasons and reviewer effort. Trigger: at least 5 reviews and below 80% accepted as-is; this is a triage threshold, not a service target.
WorkforceDashboard.feedbackAction: Recorded activity has no review decisions. First check whether this work should produce a reviewable output and whether reviews are attributed correctly. If it does, ask its owner to review a small representative sample and record specific corrections.
WorkforceDashboard.feedbackMeasure: Check next: representative reviewed outputs and actionable feedback. Background activity does not necessarily need human approval.
WorkforceDashboard.activationAction: This enabled agent has no recorded work. Confirm telemetry and intended cadence, then identify one real task, its owner and how it should reach the agent through chat, a playbook or an existing schedule.
WorkforceDashboard.activationMeasure: Check next: a useful output from the intended workflow and repeat use. Do not create activity just to raise this count.
WorkforceDashboard.sampleAction: There are too few reviewed outputs to draw a strong quality conclusion. Review more examples across routine work and edge cases before changing prompts, data access or approval policy.
WorkforceDashboard.sampleMeasure: Check next: coverage across task types and documented correction reasons; five reviews is a triage minimum, not statistical confidence.
WorkforceDashboard.noInsights: No rule-based investigation prompts in this window. This does not establish that quality or value is healthy.
WorkforceDashboard.howImprove: How do we decide what an agent needs?
WorkforceDashboard.improvementGuide: Adoption: check eligible demand and routing. Feedback: inspect edits and rejection reasons. Approvals: inspect waiting work and decision latency in the team report before changing gates. Chat: turn recurring requests into repeatable playbooks. Context and data: verify missing, stale or inaccessible evidence from actual failures. Change one thing, evaluate representative examples, then compare similar work. These triage prompts do not establish root causes.
WorkforceDashboard.cadence: Daily: inspect new exceptions and unblock work. Weekly: choose one improvement per team, name its owner and success measure, and review last week’s change. The selector shows rolling 24 hours or 7 days. These triage prompts are not yet included in the existing scheduled reports.
WorkforceDashboard.barNote: Bars show recorded agent activity coverage, not task throughput, utilization capacity or a quality score.
WorkforceDashboard.overviewTitle: See the work. Find the next improvement.
WorkforceDashboard.overviewNote: Open a workspace, select a team, then expand an agent to inspect activity, reviewed output and cost. Investigation prompts connect the evidence to a next action.
WorkforceDashboard.noWorkspaces: No accessible active workspaces in this organization.
WorkforceDashboard.scope: Only accessible, non-archived workspaces in your current organization. Activity and review coverage are incomplete; no business value is inferred.
WorkforceDashboard.existingLoop: Use the existing team report for outcomes and human intervention measures. Weekly organization reviews propose supported changes in Needs you; learned rules are reviewed separately.
WorkforceDashboard.openOutcomes: Open this workspace to review work outcomes

WorkforceOutcomes.title: Work outcomes
WorkforceOutcomes.note: One business item across attempts. Human attestation is not independent correctness verification. This cohort includes items updated in the selected window.
WorkforceOutcomes.failed: Could not save or load. Reload to check the latest revision; check the fields and outcome transition before retrying.
WorkforceOutcomes.capped: Snapshot or evidence history capped; these are not complete workspace totals.
WorkforceOutcomes.partial: Partial coverage; excludes unlinked model, tool and vendor costs
WorkforceOutcomes.empty: No registered work items in this window. Activity is not yet measured as accepted business work.
WorkforceOutcomes.stale: Linked output changed. Reopen, refresh the source link, and review again. Excluded from current accepted totals.
WorkforceOutcomes.learningNote: Current accumulated stock, with new feedback for the selected period. Cases are deduplicated within each dataset; datasets may overlap. These counts do not prove improved performance.
WorkforceOutcomes.learningCoverage: {covered}/{agents} registered agents have cases · {fresh}/{datasets} datasets have fresh results.
WorkforceOutcomes.feedbackQueue: Feedback processing: {pending} pending · {failed} failed · {applied} applied. Applied does not mean validated.
WorkforceOutcomes.learningUnknown: Reviewed gold standards, independent holdout coverage, and validated improvement: not yet measured. A reference answer is not automatically a reviewed gold standard.
WorkforceOutcomes.evalDetail: Dataset v{version} · grader {provider} · latest run {status} · pass rate {rate}
WorkforceOutcomes.evalFreshness: A displayed pass rate requires a successful run on this dataset version after its last edit, within 30 days, with a recorded configuration SHA. It does not prove the current configuration improved.
